mapper.select: /* Dashboard01Mapper.selectDashRecentAcctList */ SELECT A.ACCT_ID AS acctId , A.OCCUR_YMD AS occurYmd , A.OCCUR_TIME AS occurTime , A.OCCUR_PLACE AS occurPlace , A.ACCT_GRADE_CD AS acctGradeCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.ACCT_GRADE_CD, 'SYS065') AS acctGradeNm , A.PROCESS_STATUS_CD AS processStatusCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.PROCESS_STATUS_CD, 'SYS066') AS processStatusNm FROM TB_ACCT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.OCCUR_YMD DESC, A.OCCUR_TIME DESC, A.ACCT_ID DESC LIMIT 3

/* Dashboard01Mapper.selectPatrolMonthMiss */ WITH RECURSIVE DAYS AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(#{fromYmd}, '%Y%m%d') AS D UNION ALL SELECT D + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM DAYS WHERE D < STR_TO_DATE(#{toYmd}, '%Y%m%d') ) SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_CHKPT_TYPE_MGMT A INNER JOIN DAYS ON ( DAYS.D >= DATE(A.INSERT_DATE) -- 등록일 이후만 의무 AND (A.USE_YN = 'Y' OR DAYS.D <= DATE(A.UPDATE_DATE)) -- 비활성 개소는 UPDATE_DATE(근사)까지만 의무 ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ANSWER R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SITE_CD = A.SITE_CD AND R.CHKPT_CD = A.CHKPT_CD AND R.WORK_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(DAYS.D, '%Y%m%d') )

/* Dashboard01Mapper.selectRiskStatusCounts */ SELECT CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = '001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS reviewRequestCnt , CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = '002' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS improvePlanCnt FROM TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT A INNER JOIN ( SELECT B.SYST_VAL_D_CD FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D B WHERE B.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD FROM TB_BAIM_VAL_D C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) C ON ( A.PROCESS_CD = C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD ) INNER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE D ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = D.CMPNY_CD AND A.RISK_TYPE_CD = D.RISK_TYPE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.ASSESSMENT_STATUS IN ('001', '002')

/* Dashboard01Mapper.selectTbmMonthlyCounts */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m') AS ym , COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' AND A.ENDED_AT >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{fromDate}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND A.ENDED_AT <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{toDate}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
